integrity: All algebraic statements are supported by a full invariant-subspace decomposition; executable finite checks supplement the proof, not independent validation. Historical originality remains subject to unindexed prior literature.
limitations: Exactly two occupied vertices on balanced complete bipartite graphs, with edge-clock heat-bath exchange rates; finite-temperature spectral gap only; no claim on full mixing times, higher occupancy or thermodynamic transitions.
title: A unique antiferromagnetic mixing optimum for two-particle Kawasaki dynamics on balanced bicliques
